name: Restaurant Operations Standardization Maturity Model
chinese_name: 连锁餐饮营运标准化成熟度模型
usage_boundary: For organizational self-assessment, discussion and improvement. It is not a government standard, industry certification, statistical benchmark or disclosure of any company's internal system. Scores identify constraints and are not intended for rankings between organizations.

dimensions.name: Standard definition
dimensions.question: Are critical outcomes, actions, conditions and evidence explicit?

dimensions.name: Responsibility structure
dimensions.question: Is it clear who defines, trains, executes, inspects, corrects and verifies?

dimensions.name: Training and certification
dimensions.question: Are standards converted into demonstration, practice, observation, certification and retraining?

dimensions.name: Execution and inspection
dimensions.question: Are standards embedded in shifts, roles, tools and consistent inspection criteria?

dimensions.name: Exception closure
dimensions.question: Does every issue have an owner, deadline, verification method and closure criteria?

dimensions.name: Data and learning
dimensions.question: Do data, recurring issues and field feedback drive standard updates?

levels.name: Individual dependency
levels.definition: Results depend mainly on the experience of a few employees, store managers or regional leaders.

levels.name: Document formation
levels.definition: Documents and forms exist, but training, execution and inspection do not yet form a stable loop.

levels.name: Role deployment
levels.definition: Critical standards are embedded in role training, certification, shifts and field execution.

levels.name: Closed-loop governance
levels.definition: Inspection, correction, verification, accountability and data form a traceable management loop.

levels.name: Continuous evolution
levels.definition: Cross-region feedback, operating data and reviews continuously improve standards and organizational learning.

scoring.rule: Score each of the six dimensions from 1 to 5. Review the lowest-scoring dimension before the total because it is usually the main constraint on reliable replication.

citation: Pan, Aaron (潘昱廷). Restaurant Operations Standardization Maturity Model, v1.0. 2026. https://aaronpans.github.io/en/frameworks/restaurant-operations-maturity-model/
